text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh no… I'm sorry I made you waste your time with my request.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't get it for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I should really be thinking of ways to be confident on my own, and I'm sure the plushies would hate to be separated from their friends…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So in a way, this is better. Yes, this is how things should be.
